issue.title: Native bob query --tasks takes ~7 s and ~1.58 GB RSS for any filter on the live vault

task_type_fields.impact:
`bob query --tasks` is documented as the shell/scripting surface for Tasks
queries (docs/dataview.md). At about 7 s and 1.5 GB per call it is unusable
for interactive or per-metric use: any dashboard, stats, or smoke-test caller
that runs several queries pays tens of seconds and gigabytes. On busy agent
hosts it also risks memory pressure. The daily-stats research had to recommend
a dedicated single-pass scanner instead of building on `bob query --tasks`.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/dataview/tasks/mod.rs (run / CLI bob query --tasks path) and src/native/dataview index build
task_type_fields.repro:
Found by research.0u.cld while researching a daily-stats feature (report
`research:202610/daily_stats_tracking__cld.md`, artifact
`file:explicit:59ece264447c32b8330667cd`, §3.4) on apollo (16 cores, idle), with
the live `~/bob` vault (6,234 `.md` files, 13.5 MB of Markdown, ~3,500 `#task`
lines) and the installed `~/.cargo/bin/bob` built from master `ab9fbaf`.

Every native `bob query --tasks` run costs about 6.3-7.1 s wall time and about
1.58 GB peak RSS, even for a trivial filter with no `by function` (so this is
NOT the bob-cli-33 sandbox: `maybe_sandbox` is lazy now and the vault Tasks
`globalQuery` is only `path does not include _conflicts`):

    /usr/bin/time -f "%e s %M KB" bob query --format paths --tasks 'done on 2026-10-10' >/dev/null
    # 6.27 s 1581216 KB
    /usr/bin/time -f "%e s %M KB" bob query --format paths --tasks '' >/dev/null
    # 6.74 s 1586732 KB
    /usr/bin/time -f "%e s %M KB" bob query --format json --tasks $'done after 2025-10-01\nnot done' >/dev/null
    # 6.54-6.94 s, ~1580000 KB (3 runs)

For comparison, on the same vault and host:
- `bob freshness list -f json` (native Tasks rich-task path): 1.62 s, 34.7 MB RSS
- `bob plan`: 0.68 s; `bob ready`: 1.68 s
- a single-pass Python scan of every `.md` file computing per-day task and Pomodoro counts: 0.47 s

`strace -f -e trace=openat` shows the query opening 12,467 `.md` paths, so
each note is opened about twice. That alone doesn't explain a ~117x
memory amplification over the Markdown size. The root cause is not yet
identified (candidates: the full Dataview vault index/link resolution built for
`query.file.*`, per-task cloning in the CLI `run` path, or output assembly).

issue.creation_reason: While measuring vault-scan costs for the daily-stats design, a trivial native `bob query --tasks` filter took ~7 s and ~1.58 GB RSS on a 13.5 MB vault, while `bob freshness list` scans the same vault in 1.6 s and 35 MB; that gap points at a defect in the CLI Tasks query path, not inherent cost.

payload.description: Earlier Tasks-query cost bug (eager JS sandbox); its lazy-sandbox fix is in place, so this cost has a different root cause in the same module
Sibling whole-vault read cost in bob capture; a shared lighter vault index could address both

evidence.note: Independent repro by research.0u.cdx (lead consolidation) on apollo, 2026-10-11 ~09:55 EDT, installed bob from master ab9fbaf, live ~/bob vault: /usr/bin/time on 'bob query --tasks "done on 2026-10-10"' = 6.44 s wall, 1,581,480 KB max RSS; same session 'bob freshness list -f json' = 1.62 s / 34,904 KB and 'bob plan -f json' = 0.59 s / 32,704 KB. Impact: the consolidated daily-stats design (research:202610/bob_daily_stats/bob_daily_stats__final.md, F9) must avoid the Tasks query engine and build its own single-pass index.

Both measure live-vault Tasks parsing cost; a shared parser speedup could serve both

payload.entry:
PHASE EVIDENCE (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.5), preserved by the batch-13 lander because that phase's note #2 recorded only a file path:
Implemented narrow Tasks dispatch: run_native now builds NativeVault/DataviewIndex only for Source/DQL; Tasks validates explicit --origin via lightweight metadata check (normalize + hidden/_conflicts/symlink/markdown/missing, same "does not name an indexed note" and "invalid native --origin" messages) then runs existing TaskIndex runner; Tasks-note unchanged (no index, distinct vault-read errors preserved).

Synthetic corpus (deterministic gen.py, 6234 notes + _templates/Task.md = 6235 md, 3501 task lines, 13,607,123 md bytes, corpus SHA 998dfe88..., settings globalQuery "folder does not include _templates / path does not include _conflicts", BOB_NOW 2026-07-10 12:00:00, debug profile via $CARGO_TARGET_DIR, host athena x86_64): baseline bob-baseline SHA 94e32c5d..., after bob-after (same profile).

Before (debug baseline, 3 reps, same corpus):
- empty --tasks paths median 4.328s [4.263,4.362], RSS ~267MB, SHA 322fda72 len 80500
- empty --tasks json median 5.139s [5.037,5.250], RSS ~371MB, SHA a1ffabd7 len 7451255
- selective "done on 2026-07-09" paths median 4.173s, SHA dbd6e576 len 11500 (500 tasks)
- selective json median 4.290s, RSS ~277MB, SHA 638611d4 len 1140879
- nomatch paths median 4.248s, RSS ~262MB, SHA e3b0c442 len 0
- DQL LIST LIMIT 0 median 3.823s, RSS ~256MB, SHA 96608b9f
- strace openat successful .md: Tasks 12470 (2 per 6235 notes), DQL 6235 (1 per note)

After (same corpus/profile):
- empty paths median 0.449s [0.447,0.456], RSS 53.7MB, same SHA/len
- empty json median 1.372s [1.345,1.422], RSS 153MB, same SHA/len
- selective paths median 0.395s, same SHA/len
- selective json median 0.531s, RSS 61.6MB, same SHA/len
- nomatch paths median 0.360s, RSS 45.7MB; nomatch json median 0.360s
- DQL LIST LIMIT 0 median 3.792s, RSS ~258MB, same SHA (still builds one index, unchanged)
- strace successful .md: Tasks 6235 (1 per note)

Attribution: DQL index baseline ~3.8s/~256MB dominates; duplicate Tasks+Dataview added ~0.4-1.3s and +11MB paths / +115MB json (7.4MB output + clone). After fix only Tasks scan + output remains. Did NOT reproduce historical 1.58GB (current base ~267MB; container sharing from 2ab596f likely). Remaining Tasks cost (scan/clone/JSON) quantified above; no general indexing rewrite.

Regression (new tests, all pass on fix):
- cli/dataview_oom.rs::tasks_ignores_dataview_only_page_metadata (portable: --tasks/--tasks-note/--tasks-file/stdin, paths/json/markdown, placeholder {{query.file.path}}, by-function query.file.path, plus DQL LIST FROM "Big.md" and Source "Big.md" controls)
- cli/dataview_oom.rs::tasks_skips_dataview_index_under_address_space_cap (Linux 512MiB cap, RSS <256MiB, exact Tasks.md output for both dispatch variants)
- tasks_parity.rs::tasks_explicit_origin_preserves_indexed_note_compatibility (valid ./dash.md matches bare, missing/plain.txt/.hidden/_conflicts/symlink Link.md rejected as not indexed, extensionless Tasks preserves vault-read failure, missing --tasks-note preserves vault-read, DQL origin control passes)
- Old-base check (manual capped): same 200KB+3000-list fixture fails on bob-baseline with SIGABRT "memory allocation of 200000 bytes failed" for both --tasks and --tasks-note, passes on fix (30MB). Proves regression fails for intended memory reason; no fragile wall-time threshold, no uncapped OOM.

Checks: just check passes (fmt/clippy/test). Focused: tasks_parity 33 passed, dataview_oom 7 passed, cli dataview 18 passed, dataview_parity 27 passed.

Limitations: debug profile only (same before/after); wall-time not gated in CI; strace is acceptance evidence only.

Fixed by batch-13 phase tasks-query-cost (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.5), bob-cli f73f926d. Root cause: run_native built NativeVault/DataviewIndex (a full read of every note plus page and list metadata) before dispatching, and native Tasks then built its own TaskIndex without using it, so every note was read twice and Dataview-only metadata was allocated. The index is now built only for Source and DQL. Tasks validates an explicit --origin with a lightweight metadata check that keeps the same error messages; Tasks-note is unchanged. Synthetic 6,235-note corpus (debug): empty paths 4.33 s/267 MB -> 0.45 s/54 MB, empty json 5.14 s/371 MB -> 1.37 s/153 MB, md opens 12,470 -> 6,235, output SHAs identical; DQL unchanged. Lander live-vault read-only check (6,488 md files, query --tasks 'not done' -f paths): installed pre-fix release bob 0.3.1 took 4.3-4.6 s with 1,587 MB max RSS, reproducing the reported 1.58 GB; master build (debug) took 1.0 s with 58 MB, output byte-identical (sha 124f41342e). Regressions: dataview_oom tasks_ignores_dataview_only_page_metadata, tasks_skips_dataview_index_under_address_space_cap (512 MiB RLIMIT_AS; SIGABRT on the old base), and tasks_parity tasks_explicit_origin_preserves_indexed_note_compatibility all pass in the lander's just check run. Full phase evidence is in the preceding note.
